appliedUpdates.description: Documented that pnpm format can timeout and workers should use npx prettier directly for specific files.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add caveat that prettier expands compact markdown tables by ~20% with padding. Recommend using lists instead of tables when targeting strict character limits.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: In claudemd-compression, prettier formatting ballooned a table from 7,224 to 8,691 chars, causing failure.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Note that pre-commit security lint hooks (e.g. SEC-011) apply to markdown files and may flag intentionally insecure examples. Workers may need to avoid template literals or string interpolation in markdown code blocks.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: In rules-compress-individual, the worker was blocked from committing until they refactored an insecure string interpolation example in security.md.
